```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul optimized with stationary activation scratchpad reuse.
void solution(void) {
  int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
  uint32_t a_base = 0;
  int SPAD_DEST = 128;

  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    // Partial last M block: compute only the real rows, pad the rest.
    int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
    if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
    if (mrows <= 0) continue;

    int tiles_I = (mrows + DIM - 1) / DIM; // Number of tiles in M dimension for this block
    uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_I * tiles_K * DIM;

    // Stage only the tiny per-32-group scales for A once per i0 block
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
      memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
    }

    // MVIN A tiles DIRECTLY from DRAM once per i0 block (stationary in scratchpad)
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t)); // A rows: stride K
    for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++) {
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                              a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
      }
    }

    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
      // Partial last N block: compute only the real cols, pad the rest.
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
      if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
      if (ncols <= 0) continue;

      int tiles_J = (ncols + DIM - 1) / DIM; // Number of tiles in N dimension for this block
      int pad_i = tiles_I * DIM - mrows;
      int pad_j = tiles_J * DIM - ncols;

      // Stage only the tiny per-32-group scales for B
      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
        memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);
      }

      // Configure execution and scale factor registers
      gemmini_flush(0);
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);

      // MVIN B tiles directly from DRAM (stride N)
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
                                b_base + (k * tiles_J + j) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }

      // Configure requantizer write-back
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

      // Execute weight-stationary matmul loop using the pre-loaded scratchpad A & B tiles
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0, a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0,
                           SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Readout requantized results from SMEM to DRAM
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++) {
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][(j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD],
                             SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK, ncols);
      }
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
```
